title: Combinatorial Characterizations of the Learnability of Conditional Distributions
abstract: arXiv:2610.31890v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the PAC-learnability of function classes that map inputs to probability distributions over a finite space. The learner observes i.i.d. input-label pairs, with each label sampled from the conditional distribution of an unknown target hypothesis in the class. We measure learning through excess risk under a bounded proper loss that satisfies two mild assumptions. We introduce the \textbf{fat$_\gamma$Natarajan dimension}, which generalizes both fat$_\gamma$ and Natarajan dimension, and prove that its finiteness at every positive scale is necessary and sufficient for learnability. We also introduce a \textbf{fat$_\gamma$Graph} dimension extending the classical \gra dimension and establish inequalities comparing the two dimensions at different scales, leading to an equivalent characterization of learnability. translated_title: 条件分布可学习性的组合刻画
translated_abstract: 我们研究将输入映射到有限空间上概率分布的函数类的PAC可学习性。学习者观察独立同分布的输入-标签对，其中每个标签从该类中未知目标假设的条件分布中采样得到。我们通过在满足两个温和假设的有界正常损失下的超额风险来衡量学习效果。我们引入了fat_γ Natarajan维数，它同时推广了fat_γ维数和Natarajan维数，并证明其在每个正尺度上的有限性是可学习性的充要条件。我们还引入了fat_γ Graph维数，它是经典Graph维数的推广，并建立了在不同尺度上比较这两个维数的不等式，从而得到可学习性的等价刻画。最后，我们证明一个取值为分布的函数类是可学习的，当且仅当它的每个坐标类都是可学习的。
tldr: 本文引入fat_γ Natarajan维数和fat_γ Graph维数两个组合维度，证明前者在每个正尺度上的有限性是条件分布函数类PAC可学习性的充要条件，并证明分布值函数类可学习当且仅当其每个坐标类均可学习。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the fat_γ Natarajan dimension and the fat_γ Graph dimension, proving that finiteness of the former at every positive scale is necessary and sufficient for PAC-learnability of conditional distribution classes, and that a distribution-valued function class is learnable if and only if each of its coordinate classes is learnable.
